description: Get the cost of hiring in a country and what the law requires to employ someone there: the yearly cost of one hire through each employer of record (cost_of_hiring: gross salary at an illustration of USD 100,000, the statutory employer contributions and 12 monthly fees, lowest first, with a calculator link for any salary), what each employer of record states it charges there on its own page for the country (monthly fee per employee, lowest first), the employer's statutory contribution rate (or fixed amounts), minimum wage, annual leave, notice, severance, probation and other terms, each with its primary source. Accepts a country name, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code or slug, e.g. 'Germany', 'BR', 'united-kingdom'.

country.description: Country name, two-letter ISO code or slug.

name: get_country_employment_costs
title: Country employment costs
